author: Foundry
description: A project image well, with alt text, a focal point, named renditions and per-breakpoint selection.

controls.label: Image
controls.alt: A view across the harbour at sunset
controls.tooltip: label and alt — the initial alternative text, edited in the well's Alt field. No defaults, so it starts empty.

controls.label: Banner
controls.tooltip: focalPoint: true — adds the Focal Point button and the position, focalPointX and focalPointY values. The control becomes responsive.

controls.label: Photo
controls.tooltip: renditions — named scaled copies read as control.photo.rendition.small, each with its own width and height for srcset.

controls.label: Artwork
controls.tooltip: responsive: true — each breakpoint can pick a different image.

title: Image
